title: orders-api: elevated latency and errors
description: Customers report failed or very slow checkouts. orders-api shows elevated latency and intermittent 5xx responses.
root_cause_detail: A configuration change reduced the orders-api connection pool from 10 to 3 connections; normal traffic exhausted the pool.
expected_symptoms: connection acquisition timeouts and database errors in orders-api logs
orders-api p95 latency rises from ~110ms to ~3.7s
orders-api memory stays near baseline; CPU at most moderately elevated
configuration reload on orders-api shortly before saturation; database server connections drop
resolution: Reverted the pool size configuration and added validation for datasource settings.
